headword: {文化週間|ぶんかしゅうかん}

definitions.explanation: A designated week celebrating culture and the arts. In Japan, the national Cultural Week runs from November 1 to 7, centered around Culture Day ({文化|ぶんか}の{日|ひ}) on November 3. Schools and communities also hold their own culture weeks with exhibitions, performances, and events.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧ (culture) and ⟦{週間|しゅうかん}→週間：00988_shuukan⟧ (week/awareness week). Japan's national {文化週間|ぶんかしゅうかん} falls on November 1-7, with November 3rd being ⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Culture Day), a national holiday. Many museums and cultural institutions offer free admission or special events during this period.
